sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Canal And Drainage Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLVII OF 2001
ORDINANCE XLVII OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
CANAL AND DRAINAGE
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An
Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan
Canal
and Drainage Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette
of Balochistan, Extraordinary,
7th
November, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑54/Law/80,
dated 7‑11‑2001.‑‑The following Ordinance made by .the
Governor of Balochistan on 3rd November, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Canal and Drainage
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

2. Amendment
of section 2 of Ordinance XX of 1980.‑‑‑In the Balochistan Canal and Drainage Ordinance, 1980, hereinafter
referred to as the said Ordinance, in subsection (2) of section 2,‑‑
(a) in clause
(6), for the inverted C6fllndg and words `'Commissioner" means "a
Commissioner of a Division" the inverted comma and words "
"District Coordination Officer" means the District Coordination
Officer of a District," shall be substituted.
(b) in clause
(7), for the words "Head Revenue officer of a district, and includes a
Deputy Commissioner" the words and bracket "Executive District
Officer (Revenue) of a District" shall be substituted.
